statement: Equinix launched 'Equinix Inference Exchange' with NVIDIA and Together AI, anchoring the build on NVIDIA validated Enterprise Reference Architectures, with availability starting in Q1 2027.
why: Standardising colocation inference capacity on the GPU vendor's own reference designs makes that vendor the default choice for enterprise inference buildouts.

impact.mechanism: A colocation-scale inference offering built on the vendor's reference architecture channels enterprise inference spend into merchant-GPU deployments hosted in neutral data centers.

evidence.excerpt: AI infrastructure purpose-built to maximize AI factory throughput and minimize token cost
Equinix Inference Exchange will be available starting in Q1 2027.

confidence.basis: Vendor press release with no hardware SKUs, customer counts or capacity figures, and availability a quarter away.

dispersion: No MW/GW capacity or customer-count figures disclosed; specific NVIDIA hardware SKUs not named.
